extract_metrics_from_log: extract prediction, handler, queue, worker, CPU, memory, and GPU metrics from a TorchServe metric log file
generate_csv_benchmark_report: generate a CSV benchmark report with batch size, concurrency, model, and latency artifacts
extract_ab_benchmark_artifacts: extract throughput, latency percentiles, and error rate from Apache Bench (AB) benchmark results
extract_locust_benchmark_artifacts: extract throughput, latency percentiles, and error rate from Locust benchmark JSON results
generate_latency_graph: generate a bar chart graph showing prediction latency per request from benchmark data
